findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice mcqs for Chapter 19 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 160 questions numbered 1-160; by section: 19.1 9, 19.2 8, 19.3 7, 19.4 34, 19.5 13, 19.6 6, 19.7 31, 19.8 14, 19.9 3, 19.9.1 29, 19.10 6. Covers every section 19.1-19.10 in order (catenation, hydrocarbons, functional groups, IUPAC nomenclature and the 13 classes, molecular/empirical/structural formulae, formula from skeletal formula, bond fission, reagents, the seven reaction types, free radical and polar mechanisms, isomerism, optical and cis-trans isomerism, thalidomide). Formula counts and 2ⁿ values were recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise. Book corrections followed: KCN (not KCl), alkanes (not alkenes) compared with alcohols, 1-iodo-3-methylbutane, NH in secondary amines, 2-methylpropanenitrile, CH₃ in 3-methylbutanal, 4-chlorobutanal, empirical formula of ethanamide C₂H₅NO, P not in the carbocation list, seven reaction types, 2-bromopropane from propene, ethene from elimination, p orbitals, attached (not attacked), thalidomide re-marketed under strict controls.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
